purpose: A component-selective kOA development workstation hosted on Windows 11 with WSL2. The profile supports isolated workspaces, reproducible Python development through UV, selective OCI containers, local runtime testing, and optional non-authoritative workbenches. It does not establish sovereign Linux, production, high-assurance, release-signing, or control-plane conformance.
